title: One line of results/per_program.jsonl (written by HSTAT_GEN's analyze_full.py)
$comment: Written 2026-11-11 by pkg:SHARED. Implements FULL_PREREG sections 3 (classes, magnitude, silent, locally silent, warned on 2.3.3, 3.x-only), 8 (sensitivities), 10.2 (harm pre-label), 11 (labels). Targets are keyed by comparison pair id (conventions section 4.2).

clean_on_233.description: E0a completes with result and E0b IDENTICAL (section 3)

exclusion.description: why the program is not clean on 2.3.3 (null if clean)

exclusion_detail.description: e.g. E0a status error:KeyError, no_result, E0b class ORDER_ONLY

three_x_only.description: not clean on 2.3.3 but E1 completes with a result (section 3, S7)

warned_E0a.description: E0a emitted >=1 pandas Future/Deprecation/PendingDeprecation warning (section 3 definition; pilot definition as sensitivity)

exposure_match.description: catalogue ids whose frozen exposure regex (tasks/exposure_regex.tsv) matches the program text

duplicate_body_of.description: program_id of the first identical body (whitespace-normalised) within the same task and model

targets.description: keys are comparison pair ids: E0a~E1, E0a~E2, E0pa~E3, E0pa~E4, C1~E0a, V-clean__E0a~V-clean__E1, V-dirty__E0a~V-dirty__E1

class.description: null when the program is excluded on its baseline or run_problem is set

class_pilot_rule.description: sensitivity: order and dtype never drift (pilot rule)

run_problem.description: MISSING = no run record; HARNESS = canon_error/harness_error (must be 0 at T10)

magnitude.description: drift only; NO_RESULT, ORDER_DRIFT, DTYPE_DRIFT are SUBSTANTIVE

silent.description: PRIMARY: SUBSTANTIVE drift and no pandas warning anywhere in the target run

silent_all_magnitudes.description: sensitivity: any-magnitude drift with no pandas warning

locally_silent.description: drift with no pandas warning at or before the first divergent line; null if not drift or line unknown

warned_target.description: any pandas warning (any category) in the target run

warning_only.description: values equal (IDENTICAL/DTYPE_ONLY) and the target emits a pandas warning signature the baseline did not

labels.description: catalogue ids / family codes / UNATTRIBUTED (drift only)
